explanation: TeX only allows one `_` directly on a base, and this line has two — `x_1_2` does not say whether the second `_` attaches to `x` or to `1`. If both parts belong in one subscript together, group them: `x_{1,2}`. If a `_` was meant as ordinary text rather than a script, wrap it in `\text{}` instead.
title: Two subscripts on the same base
